en.text: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

zhSimplified.text: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 在 神的圣所赞美他！ 在他显能力的穹苍赞美他！

zhTraditional.text: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 在上帝的聖所讚美他！ 在他顯能力的穹蒼讚美他！

en.text: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

zhSimplified.text: 要因他大能的作为赞美他， 按着他极美的大德赞美他！

zhTraditional.text: 要因他大能的作為讚美他， 按着他極美的大德讚美他！

en.text: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

zhSimplified.text: 要用角声赞美他， 鼓瑟弹琴赞美他！

zhTraditional.text: 要用角聲讚美他， 鼓瑟彈琴讚美他！

en.text: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

zhSimplified.text: 击鼓跳舞赞美他！ 用丝弦的乐器和箫的声音赞美他！

zhTraditional.text: 擊鼓跳舞讚美他！ 用絲弦的樂器和簫的聲音讚美他！

en.text: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

zhSimplified.text: 用大响的钹赞美他！ 用高声的钹赞美他！

zhTraditional.text: 用大響的鈸讚美他！ 用高聲的鈸讚美他！

en.text: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!

zhSimplified.text: 凡有气息的都要赞美耶和华！ 你们要赞美耶和华！

zhTraditional.text: 凡有氣息的都要讚美耶和華！ 你們要讚美耶和華！
